notes: REPORT COORDINATE PROBLEM: Table 11 gives 44.175722, -72.661631, which lands in the Dog River valley about 10 miles east — almost certainly a transcription error. Report: the upper Mad above Warren Village has excellent high-gradient forested habitat and some of the highest trout numbers in the watershed, mostly wild brookies with occasional rainbows, managed for wild trout.
